scenes.headline: Design a flying fish
scenes.narration: Can we take a fish—and help it fly? Start with a goal: design a flying fish.
scenes.visual_direction: Record actual Home goal input #goalq being typed and submitted. This routes to existing project/questions; show that behavior, never an instant organism generation. Transition to actual candidate turntable.

scenes.headline: Evidence-led science. Goal-driven engineering.
scenes.narration: We bring Delphi’s literature-derived claims and equations into a shared workspace. Claims are scientific statements with sources, conditions and evidence. Design requirements then expose missing knowledge—so others can investigate, reuse or challenge it.
scenes.visual_direction: Actual Knowledge claim detail, source citation, context and review state; then graph. Overlay: Claim + context + provenance. Explain imported claim is not automatically true.

scenes.headline: Humans set goals. Evidence constrains choices.
scenes.narration: Designers can intervene at every scale: change a parameter, inspect an equation, contest a claim, or choose the next experiment.
scenes.visual_direction: Actual scale navigation, equation/control widget, exact-version annotation and prospective Experimentation. Do not submit spurious public records for filming.

scenes.headline: Specialists, reviewers and a shared frontier
scenes.narration: Specialist agents investigate different pieces. Through our MCP server, they discover questions, read exact evidence, propose work and share versioned results. Independent reviewers have caught design errors.
scenes.visual_direction: Actual MCP tool surface, contribution/history evidence and independent review case. On-screen distinct contributing-harness count only after ledger audit; timestamp and count unit mandatory. Explain deployed commons is one hosted node and much work is coordinator-assigned; no fully autonomous or federated deployment claim.

scenes.headline: Checks stay with the result—even when they fail
scenes.narration: Validation stays attached: numerical controls, independent reviews, and scoped Lean proofs. Failed checks remain visible. Our controlled comparison has not yet shown a collective performance advantage.
scenes.visual_direction: Actual Lean parameter-bound theorem/check with mutant; compiler axes and retained v3b failure. Small caption: Formal model properties, not biological validity. Benchmark card briefly shows tied result, not superiority.

scenes.headline: Across scales: simulate, inspect, identify the next gap
scenes.narration: Explore twenty-three retrieved genome archives, molecular motion, cell voltages, fin mechanics and schooling simulations. Missing links between scales become explicit research questions, rather than invented biology.
scenes.visual_direction: Actual saved-state clips of MD, BETSE/bioelectric, aeroelastic fin, ecology school; genome archive receipt or regulatory source view. Models are separate bounded studies, not a coupled end-to-end living organism. Preserve each model/status label.

scenes.headline: An ecosystem of compute, models and reusable evidence
scenes.narration: Nebius NVIDIA GPUs and Google Cloud powered computations. We used Gemini, Evo two scoring, OpenFold two and local OpenResearch. NVIDIA BioNeMo and Brev remain integration opportunities.
scenes.visual_direction: Separate USED: Nebius H100/NVIDIA CUDA; Google Cloud/Gemini; Evo2 scoring; upstream OpenFold2; local OpenResearch. FUTURE INTEGRATIONS: NVIDIA BioNeMo/NIM, Brev—execution not established. Do not attribute upstream OpenFold2 to NIM. Caption uses correct Nebius spelling even if pronunciation dictionary differs.

scenes.headline: Design → test → contest → learn → reuse
scenes.narration: The goal is a plausible synthetic organism. Today, we have computational designs and a way to test what remains unknown. Join the frontier—and make the next result reusable.
scenes.visual_direction: Actual biological candidate + evidence graph + clean frontier.morphoswarm.ai endcard. Mention nanopublication-compatible claims in visual footer, not a fabricated distribution network. No printable fish scenes: preserve the physical prop as a live-pitch surprise.
